SELECT AirportCode
FROM airports
WHERE AirportCode IN (
    SELECT SourceAirport AS AirportCode
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY SourceAirport
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DestAirport AS AirportCode
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY DestAirport
)
GROUP BY AirportCode
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM (
        SELECT AirportCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM (
            SELECT SourceAirport AS AirportCode FROM flights
            UNION ALL
            SELECT DestAirport AS AirportCode FROM flights
        )
        GROUP BY AirportCode
    )
);
